Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and signed attestation for SIG review

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG assessment we need a concise packet showing Redwood's BCP/DR posture for the inference platform used by Clearbridge. Specifically we need:  
- RTO and RPO targets for public API and Dedicated pools, with recent measured results (last 12 months)
- DR runbook location and a signed attestation that the runbook is current
- Copy of the most recent DR test execution (logs, duration, restore steps)
- Backup retention schedule and evidence (snapshots, S3 lifecycle, etc.)

Deadline for our audit window is EOD Friday 2026-08-13. Can you confirm what you can provide and by when? If there is an existing attestation link (DocuSign or similar) we can accept that.

Best,
Alex Ramos
Clearbridge Security — Vendor Risk
audits@clearbridge.com

Note: We may send a short follow-up questionnaire about warm-cache and KV restore timings depending on the answers.

Adding the ops details. Alex — brief summary of measured results from our most recent full DR exercise on 2026-08-02 (playbook-driven test):

- Hosted API (multi-tenant): target RTO = 15 minutes (control-plane failover for routing + cold-start mitigations). Observed median restore time across runs = 13 minutes. RPO (data) = 5 minutes (we use incrementals + WAL shipping).
- Dedicated pools (Reserved capacity): target RTO = 30 minutes for GPU pool rehydration and model KV restore; observed median = 28 minutes. RPO = 15 minutes for KV/short-lived caches; snapshots validated to within target.

Attached: RTO_RPO_Test_Summary_20260802.csv (per-test durations), KV_Warm_Cache_Timings_20260802.txt (per-shard timings), backup_retention_matrix.csv (policy export).

Operational notes:
- The DR exercise included simulated AZ failure + controller failover and a warm-KV snapshot restore for two critical models.
- We maintain encrypted snapshots retained for 90 days by default; longer retention available via policy for enterprise contracts.
- There were two remediation tickets opened post-test (OP-4632: optimize KV warming; OP-4633: increase snapshot frequency for a subset of customers). Both are linked in the retention matrix.

Let me know if you want raw logs; we can provide redacted logs.

Ben Carter
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rto_rpo_test_summary_20260802.csv (CSV, 420KB)
Attachment: kv_warm_cache_timings_20260802.txt (TXT, 18KB)
Attachment: backup_retention_matrix.csv (CSV, 24KB)

From: jane.wu@montclairbank.com

Subject: Follow-up: confirmation items and attestation format

Olga — thanks for the quick replies and the artifacts. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize:  

1) We need a signed attestation that the runbook in your packet is the latest live document and that the DR exercise referenced was performed under your standard change control (include ticket ids). A single company-level attestation is fine as long as it references the runbook id and date.
2) Please include a small table mapping the RTO/RPO targets to customer-impacting features (e.g., API inference, KV cache, admin console) — this helps risk scoring.
3) We also need the backup retention evidence exported as a CSV with timestamps showing the snapshot creation dates for the past 60 days (not just the policy).

Finally, will Redwood sign the attestation via DocuSign? If so, please send the link and we will countersign.

Regards,
Jane Wu
Vendor Risk — Montclair Bank (procurement on behalf of Clearbridge)
jane.wu@montclairbank.com

P.S. We prefer attachments under 10MB in the packet; redaction is acceptable for customer IDs.
